The company expanded its Kraków AI engineering center with plans for headcount to exceed 660 by 2027.
HDFC Mutual Fund reduced its shareholding in Coforge to 4.30% on October 6, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 4.07% portfolio weight, Coforge is the fund's largest holding and delivered a 19.84% 3-month return, contributing an estimated +0.81% to fund performance.

watch.text: Workforce expansion progress at the Kraków engineering center toward the 660 employee target by 2027.
Enterprise adoption of the newly launched CXNova and intent engineering frameworks.

holdings.name: Multi Commodity Exchange Of India Ltd

what_changed.text: MCX received a GST show-cause notice dated September 29, 2026 proposing Rs 54.08 crore in tax, Rs 43.82 crore in interest, and Rs 5.41 crore in penalty.
The company appointed Ramesh Varakhedkar as Chief Business Officer effective September 28, 2026.
MCX reassigned key managerial roles across metals, research, strategy, and training on October 8, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 3.31% weight in the portfolio, MCX gained 21.85% over 3 months, adding an estimated +0.72% contribution to the fund.

watch.text: Legal and financial developments regarding the Rs 103+ crore GST show-cause notice proceedings.

holdings.name: Ipca Laboratories Ltd

expected.text: Management raised full-year guidance to 14-16% growth with an operating margin of 23%.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.84% weight, Ipca rose 4.10% over 3 months, generating an estimated +0.12% return contribution for the fund.

watch.text: Execution against the raised 14-16% full-year top-line growth guidance and 23% operating margin target.

holdings.name: Phoenix Mills Ltd

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.73% fund weight, Phoenix Mills fell 14.58% over 3 months, creating an estimated -0.40% drag on performance.

holdings.name: The Federal Bank Ltd

Federal Bank launched the Verto Resident Savings Account on October 7, 2026.
The bank scheduled a board meeting for October 16, 2026 to review Q2 FY27 standalone and consolidated results.

holdings.why_it_matters: With a 2.56% weight in the portfolio, Federal Bank dropped 1.29% over 3 months, representing a modest detractor inside the fund's 22.1% financials exposure.

holdings.name: Fortis Healthcare Ltd

what_changed.text: The Supreme Court disposed of the Fortis SLP and allowed a forensic audit in the Daiichi Sankyo dispute without liability, penalty, or fines.
Hospital stocks tumbled after the Supreme Court raised questions over steep healthcare markups, followed by reports of cancer drug price caps.
IHH Healthcare stated plans to increase its Fortis stake to 51% and expand capacity to 10,000 beds by 2031.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.53% weight, Fortis declined 21.41% over 3 months, making it the fund's largest individual performance drag with an estimated -0.54% contribution.

watch.text: Progress and findings of the Supreme Court-directed forensic audit in the Daiichi Sankyo matter.
Regulatory scrutiny on hospital markup practices and pricing interventions.

The Delhi High Court dismissed an appeal by T K Jain on October 1, 2026.

holdings.why_it_matters: Weighted at 2.51%, Bharat Forge fell 15.39% over 3 months, dampening fund returns within the 14.7% Consumer Discretionary bucket.

watch.text: Commercial execution milestones under the Pratt & Whitney Canada aerospace supply contract.

holdings.name: Max Financial Services Ltd

The board scheduled a meeting for October 27, 2026 to consider Q2 and half-year FY26 results.
Insurance shares fell amid market caution regarding potential earnings impacts from IRDAI regulatory proposals.

holdings.why_it_matters: At a 2.48% weight, Max Financial retreated 19.94% over 3 months, taking away an estimated -0.50% from portfolio return.

watch.text: Q2 and half-year FY26 financial results consideration by the board on October 27, 2026.
Regulatory developments regarding IRDAI proposals and their effect on expense-of-management compliance.

The board scheduled a meeting on October 28, 2026 to approve Q2 and half-year FY26 financial statements.

holdings.why_it_matters: Representing 2.44% of the fund, Cholamandalam declined 12.71% over 3 months, adding downward pressure on the fund's 22.1% financials allocation.

watch.text: Board consideration and approval of Q2 and half-year FY26 financial statements on October 28, 2026.

what_changed.text: APL Apollo reported Q2 FY27 sales volume of 963,143 tonnes, up 13% YoY and 29% QoQ.
The company raised product prices in late September with further hikes implemented from October 1, 2026.
Shareholders approved an Rs 8.50 per share final dividend at the 41st AGM.

holdings.why_it_matters: Holding a 2.34% fund weight, APL Apollo surged 17.97% over 3 months, contributing an estimated +0.42% to fund performance.

watch.text: Volume trajectory and price realization trends following the October price hikes.

portfolio.statement: DSP Midcap Fund recorded a 3-month return of -5.97%, pulled down by sharp pullbacks in healthcare, life insurance, and discretionary holdings despite counterbalancing strength in technology and capital markets infrastructure.
interp: Technology and exchange holdings Coforge (+19.84%) and MCX (+21.85%) together contributed an estimated +1.53% to returns, supported by business expansions.
Severe corrections in Fortis Healthcare (-21.41%), Max Financial (-19.94%), and Voltas (-24.42%) subtracted significant performance amid regulatory and judicial headwinds.
portfolio.line: Gains from IT and exchange volume growth were offset by legal scrutiny in healthcare and regulatory concerns in financials.

drivers.text: Coforge gained 19.84% over 3 months following its AI platform launch and Kraków center expansion.
MCX advanced 21.85% over 3 months amid leadership reorganization and active retail and foreign investor participation.
Fortis Healthcare fell 21.41% over 3 months as Supreme Court remarks on hospital markups and a forensic audit weighed on sentiment.
Max Financial dropped 19.94% over 3 months after brokerages raised concerns over earnings impacts from IRDAI regulatory proposals.
